# sks3200_vlan_8021q (Resource)

An 802.1Q VLAN and its member ports. The switch refuses to remove a port from its PVID's VLAN; change the port's sks3200_port_vlan first. A port is untagged in at most one VLAN: adding it here silently removes it from the VLAN it was untagged in. VLAN 1 can't be deleted: import it, and destroying it only drops it from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sks3200_vlan_8021q" "guest" {
  vlan_id        = 20
  name           = "guest"
  untagged_ports = [3, 4]
  tagged_ports   = [9]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vlan_id` (Number) 802.1Q VLAN ID, 1-4094.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Up to 16 characters.
- `tagged_ports` (Set of Number) Ports (1-based) that send this VLAN's frames tagged.
- `untagged_ports` (Set of Number) Ports (1-based) that send this VLAN's frames untagged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The VLAN ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The factory default VLAN 1 can't be created, only imported.
terraform import sks3200_vlan_8021q.default 1
```
